module.name: ADB power (Android TV / Google TV)
module.description: Turns an Android TV or Google TV on and off over network ADB.

host.title: TV IP address
host.description: Address of the TV on the local network.

timeout_ms.title: Maximum delay (ms)
timeout_ms.description: Maximum duration of one ADB operation.

unreachable_means_off.title: Unreachable means off
unreachable_means_off.description: Treat the TV as off when it stops answering (deep standby without network).

adb.accept_on_tv: Accept the debugging key on the TV (tick "Always allow").

android.unreachable: TV unreachable: enable network debugging and check the IP address.
android.tls_required: This TV only accepts encrypted wireless debugging: enable classic “Network debugging” (port 5555).
android.accept_on_tv: Accept the prompt on the TV and tick “Always allow”.
android.unauthorized: Authorization refused or expired: retry and choose “Always allow”.
android.protocol: Unexpected ADB response from the TV.
android.already_installed: App already up to date on the TV.
android.install_incompatible: A differently signed version is already installed: uninstall the app from the TV.
android.owner_exists: Another device owner already exists on the TV.
android.accounts_present: Accounts (Google) are present: remove accounts and profiles, resume at this step, then add them back afterwards. Otherwise, soft kiosk.
android.extra_users: Several profiles exist: remove them to enable Device Owner.
android.dpm_refused: The TV refuses Device Owner (a factory reset may be required).
android.soft_kiosk_active: Soft kiosk active: Home and Assistant keys remain usable. Use only for non-public screens.
android.no_kiosk: No lock-down: the app is not protected.
android.inject_failed: Could not pass the pairing to the TV.
android.no_provider: No provisioning driver for this platform.

2.title: Enable network debugging
2.body: In developer options, enable “USB debugging” then “Network debugging” (port 5555), not wireless debugging.

3.title: Google account
3.body: For full lock-down (Device Owner), remove all accounts and profiles from the TV first, then add them back after installation.

4.title: Note the IP address
4.body: Note the TV IP address (Settings > Network) and reserve it in the router.

5.title: Accept the prompt
5.body: During installation, accept the debugging prompt on the TV and tick “Always allow”.
